title: Motion Blur - Remastered
summary: Standalone Classic optical motion blur with frame-rate-compensated exposure and fence-retired GPU scratch for DX12.
notes: Enhanced activates motion blur automatically on supported executable builds; Native respects the game's Motion Blur On/Off setting.
Works independently of tone mapping, with SDR or HDR. Designed to coexist with the current Witcher HDR and Darker Nights addons.
Do not combine with the historical HDR addon that already includes enhanced motion blur.
